newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Court declares Bulgaria's Slavyani Bank insolvent.
newsitem.headline: Court declares Bulgaria's Slavyani Bank insolvent.

text.p: Sofia City Court on Monday declared Bulgaria's private Slavyani Bank insolvent on the basis of its unpaid liabilities to the central bank, a court official said.
The bank can appeal against the ruling within seven days.

Bank liabilities to the central bank totalled 410 million levs plus 293 million levs of principal under five contracts signed with the Bulgarian National Bank, the court said in a statement. A further $588,000 was owed to the central bank under a sixth contract, it said.
Slavyani Bank was placed in receivership on September 23 with a negative capital to risk assets ratio of 38.67 percent and outstanding payments to other banks worth 223 million levs.

The BNB filed an insolvency suit against the bank on October 31. So far Bulgaria has declared four other banks insolvent, and has withdrawn the licence of First Private Bank. Insolvency suits against another eight state and private banks are pending.
